purpose: Document how V8/V8.1 modifies the scheme according to the calibrated external-score model.

v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.change: Restored Public Value Passport as a dedicated proposal section and connected it to E0-E5 evidence levels, G0-G4 gates, RACI, SLO, rollback, and retirement assets.
v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.expected_external_signal: Recovers the highest-scoring V3 civic-value spine.

v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.change: Added distributed source/data/depth/metric anchors across first-principles, protocol, key-area, hard-parameter, and peer-calibration sections.
v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.expected_external_signal: Improves machine-visible traceability without placing long evidence runs in one paragraph.

v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.change: Restored route comparison among media corridor, landmark cluster, and public-value commons; selected the third based on public access, knowledge conversion, rights, reversibility, and evidence.
v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.expected_external_signal: Shows why the proposal's strategic direction is chosen rather than merely described.

v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.change: Added a Digital Urban Design Protocol section defining boundaries, lines, areas, points, gates, allowed algorithmic roles, and prohibited automated decisions.
v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.expected_external_signal: Makes AI governance reviewable as a contract rather than a visual theme.

v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.change: Regenerated V8.1 drawings so the three-court section differentiation, hard parameters, ground-floor interfaces, slow-mobility repairs, and evidence edge appear directly on boards.
v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.expected_external_signal: Connects urban form to program, rights, operations, evidence, and visible spatial specificity.

v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.change: Added a hard planning parameter table and a matching drawing asset, visual/assets/hard_parameter_spatialization_v8.json, covering site area, civic grounds, green overlay, building envelopes, slow-mobility network, intensity controls, and operating metrics.
v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.expected_external_signal: Turns drawings into reviewable planning and delivery objects.

v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.change: Kept provisional geometry and unknown controls as explicit limits; did not fabricate official redlines, FAR, height, density, setbacks, demolition quantity, or post-occupancy performance.
v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.expected_external_signal: Maintains gate readiness while avoiding false precision.

v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.change: Synchronized Chinese and English proposal revisions, regenerated proposal HTML, regenerated six core figure pairs, and regenerated A0/A3 PDF boards.
v8_changes_by_calibrated_weight.expected_external_signal: Keeps bilingual packaging as a gate, not a substitute for content quality.

calibrated_forecast_after_v8_1.confidence: medium; forecast is based on four external historical scores, restored V3 content spine, and V8.1 drawing-visible hard parameters, not on access to the Review Agent model
